shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 3 'dashboard|data grid|table|app shell|navigation' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh table DataTable Table && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Icon Text'

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh table DataTable Table && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Icon Text'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md && rg -n -C 3 'group|column order|reorder|selection|DataTable|useTable|drag|Grouping' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs && rg -n -C 3 'AsideHeader|menuItems|collapsed|renderContent' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md && rg -n -C 2 'ThemeProvider|Button view|Typography|Icon data' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '"'^#### Column reordering|''^#### Grouping|''^#### Row selection|''^#### Styling|''^## Required|''^## Install'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md; sed -n '430,530p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md; rg -n '\"@gravity-ui/icons\"|\"@bem-react/classname\"' package.json; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | rg -n -C 2 'peerDependencies|\"@gravity-ui/icons\"|\"@bem-react/classname\"'; rg -n -C 2 'getToggleExpandedHandler|ColumnReorderingProvider|enableGrouping|grouping' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -120"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | head -35; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -30; cat package.json'

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/{House,Person,Cart,ShoppingCart,Settings,Gear,Sliders,Box,Package,Receipt,ChartLine,Search,Plus,ArrowRotateRight,Ellipsis,Calendar,Clock,ChevronDown}.d.ts 2>/dev/null; rg -n 'CSS API|className|TableProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md | tail -25; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -80; rg -n 'export.*Table|interface TableProps|type TableProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts | head -100; rg -n 'type LabelTheme|interface LabelProps|theme:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label -g '*.d.ts' | head -30; rg -n 'display-2|subheader-2' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head"
